mr_title: Updated request.auser() in contrib.auth.alogin() and contrib.auth.alogout().

expected_issues.title: alogin()/alogout() no longer update request.user
expected_issues.description:
alogin()/alogout() now update only request.auser and stop updating request.user, so after an async logout request.user still refers to the previously authenticated user.

Before the change, alogin() and alogout() set request.user; now they only replace request.auser. Code in the same request that reads request.user (sync middleware, templates, permission checks) sees a stale value: the old user remains authenticated for the rest of the request after alogout(), and remains anonymous after alogin(). Both attributes must be updated.
